minutes.headline: Finance Committee again deferred a recommendation on accepting Butterfly Lane and planned department-head sessions before budget season.
minutes.summary: The committee reviewed warrant articles for the special Town Meeting, discussing the liquor license home rule petitions and the Butterfly Lane road acceptance, and kept its deferral on the road. Minutes of two earlier meetings were taken up.

The committee plans to meet November 7, invite department heads, and hear any police agreement; the definition goal goes on the Nov 7 or 14 agenda.

why_it_matters: Accepting Butterfly Lane would make the road a town responsibility, so upkeep such as catch basin cleaning and later paving would fall on the town budget, mostly taxes, and the committee has not yet said whether it supports that.
The department-head workshops are where FY budget requests are first discussed, and many will not be televised, so residents who want to follow them may need to attend or check postings.
